title: ablation-grade.sh and Dockerfile.ablation: grade by image digest (refuse or record when the tag's digest differs from the batch MANIFEST), pin the CLI installs with integrity hashes, drop the no-op root npm ignore-scripts line — Bridgebuilder PR #1283 F-LOW
description: BB on PR #1283: the grader launches loa-ablation:258 by tag while provenance records the digest (a rebuilt tag would grade under a different environment undetected); the Dockerfile's npm config set ignore-scripts runs as root (writes /root/.npmrc, never read by evaluser — only the ENV line has effect) and installs the two CLIs without lockfile/integrity pins; apt floats. Fix: resolve the tag's digest at grade time and refuse/record a mismatch (or run by loa-ablation@sha256:…); record npm dist.integrity per CLI and verify; delete the no-op RUN line. Not changed in cycle-130 because it would change the pinned image digest.

lib-content.sh prepare_content: recognise git's quoted diff --git "a/…" headers and fail closed on unparsed headers (hunks currently fold into the preceding file's chunk)
description:
sprint-250 audit dissent run 3 finding 9: the splitter matches only the bare 'diff --git a/

b/

' header. With core.quotePath=true (git default) any path with a non-ASCII byte, quote, backslash or control character is emitted as 'diff --git "a/..." "b/..."' and never matches; under a UTF-8 locale a header with an invalid byte fails the regex too. Unrecognised headers fall into the else branch, so the file's hunks are appended to the PRECEDING file's chunk and inherit its priority and is_excluded verdict. Pre-existing (not touched by cycle-126 beyond the stderr sanitiser). Fix: match '^diff --git ("?)a/', unquote C-style octal escapes for the quoted form (or run git diff with -c core.quotePath=false / -z and parse under LC_ALL=C), and treat any 'diff --git ' line that yields no path as a parse failure (fail closed), with a CMP case for each shape.
